title: 第9章 恨铁不成钢的大哥第10章 父亲 其实妹妹更好哦
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: 龙蛇山的鱼塘里，有很多灵鱼，这些鱼儿都长大了，到了出售的时候，陈初阳交给三叔去处理，这些事情一直都是三叔处理，无需他出手，也无需他动手。
当然了，他也会在旁边帮忙，毕竟，三叔一个人捕捉，不知道捕捉到什么时候，先放水，然后捉鱼，这个过程需要时间，好在三叔可以加快流水的速度，这一步，也需要等待，陈初阳看着三叔忙前忙后，十分忙碌。
捉鱼，是一件非常快乐的事情，快的话，一年可以看到一次，慢的话，两三年一次，这些灵鱼都是陈家消化，大部分都是供应给陈家的客栈销售，赚取灵石。
一部分留给陈家内部消化，灵鱼肉可以促进修炼，乃是不可多得的肉类，比起某些妖兽肉自然不如，可是这种灵鱼肉没有什么副作用，也很美味，稍微烹饪一下就可以吃，鲜甜，美味，肉质也很好吃，大人小孩都适合吃，最适合家族里面的那些锻体的小孩子吃。
鱼肉在陈家可是供不应求的，需求量很大，还没捕捉，就有人来问了，他们找不到陈初阳，只能找到三叔陈深帮忙，三叔早就盘下来，不愁没有销路。
忙活了一个下午，鱼塘里的灵鱼全部捕捉完成，剩下一些小的灵鱼，全部放回去，各种品类都有一些，这些需要继续成长，同时呢，三叔也带来了一批鱼苗，这些鱼苗是三叔在外面购买的，都是一些比较稀罕的鱼苗。
“初阳小子，这是这一次灵鱼的灵石。”
按照分配好的来分配，这些灵鱼，上交一部分给家族，多余的才是陈初阳的酬劳，也就是他，换做其他人呢，不亏本都算好，三叔陈深看着自己藏起来的鱼儿，十分满意。
他的手里有几个储物袋，可以存放很多鱼儿，还剩下一些，需要分批运走。
“这一次的灵鱼比去年多了五分之一，你小子养鱼能力真的很牛逼，整个陈家，也就你能够做到这一步。”
“养鱼，种植灵药，还有各种和种田有关的事情，你小子的天赋真的没的说。”
陈初阳笑着摆手：“没有，三叔谬赞了。”
三叔陈深闻言，哈哈大笑：“你小子还是那么谦虚，放心吧，三叔可不会乱说的。”
这些事情，有心人是可以查出来的。
不过，他不会让矛头指向了这个侄子。
“赚了这么多灵石，你小子要不要和三叔去放松放松？”
“三叔可是知道很多美女，各种年龄段都有，初阳侄儿，你想要哪一种，三叔都能给你找到。”
“嘻嘻嘻。”
色眯眯的表情让人很无语，陈初阳推开了三叔。
“三叔，你再这样，我告诉我母亲咯。”
“别，你小子别乱说，你母亲可暴力了，三叔承受不住。”
三叔陈深很害怕陈初阳的母亲，暴力起来，可就没其他人什么事情。
陈家最狠的人不是陈渊，而是陈初阳的母亲，很多人都害怕主母。
陈深小时候，可没少被欺负。
从小揍到大，可谓是十分凄惨，一直都活在嫂子的阴影下。
可能，这也是他一直没有成亲的缘故吧。
多少，有这方面的原因。
“算了，不和你说了，你小子万一投诉我，我岂不是？”
三叔陈深可不想看到那个画面，一想到了嫂子那副模样，不由得浑身哆嗦。
陈初阳笑着摇摇头，目送三叔离去。
“三叔还是没长大。”
数了数手里的灵石，可不少呢。
陈初阳收起来，堵上了鱼塘的缺口，开始了蓄水。
灵泉水流入了鱼塘，那些鱼苗全部放进去，很快适应了里面的生活。
content_en:
There are many spiritual fish in the fish pond in Longshe Mountain. These fish have grown up. When it comes time to sell them, Chen Chuyang leaves it to his third uncle to handle. These matters have always been handled by his third uncle, without his need to take action or his hands.
Of course, he will also be there to help. After all, Third Uncle catches alone and doesn't know when he will catch the fish. He releases the water first and then catches the fish. This process takes time. Fortunately, Third Uncle can speed up the flow of water. This step also requires waiting. Chen Chuyang watched Third Uncle busy before and after.
Catching fish is a very happy thing. If you go quickly, you can see it once a year. If you go slowly, you can see it once every two or three years. These spiritual fish are digested by the Chen family, and most of them are supplied to the Chen family's inn to sell them to earn spiritual stones.
Part of it is left for internal digestion in the Chen family. Spirit fish meat can promote cultivation and is a rare meat. It is naturally inferior to some monster meat. However, this kind of spirit fish meat has no side effects and is also very delicious. It can be eaten with a little cooking. It is fresh, sweet, delicious, and the meat is very delicious. It is suitable for adults and children, and is most suitable for those children in the family who are exercising.
Fish and meat are in short supply in the Chen family. The demand is very high. Before they can catch it, someone comes to ask. They can't find Chen Chuyang, so they can only ask the third uncle Chen Shen for help. The third uncle has already bought it, so there is no need to worry about the lack of sales.
After a busy afternoon, all the spiritual fish in the fish pond were caught, and some small spiritual fish were left. They were all put back. There were some of various categories. These needed to continue to grow. At the same time, the third uncle also brought a batch of fry. These fry were purchased by the third uncle outside, and they were all relatively rare fry.
"Boy Chuyang, this is the spirit stone of the spirit fish this time."
Distribute them according to the allocation. Some of these spiritual fish will be handed over to the family, and the rest will be Chen Chuyang's reward. That is, he, if it were anyone else, it would be fine without losing money. Third uncle Chen Shen looked at the fish he had hidden and was very satisfied.
He has several storage bags in his hand, which can store a lot of fish, and there are still some left that need to be transported in batches.
"There are one-fifth more spiritual fish this time than last year. Your fish-raising ability is really great. In the entire Chen family, you are the only one who can do this."
"Raising fish, growing elixirs, and all kinds of things related to farming, your boy's talents are really beyond words."
Chen Chuyang smiled and waved his hands: "No, Third Uncle is so complimentary."
When Third Uncle Chen Shen heard this, he laughed loudly: "You are still so humble, don't worry, Third Uncle will not talk nonsense."
Those who are interested can find out these things.
However, he would not let the finger be pointed at his nephew.
"After earning so many spiritual stones, do you want to go relax with your third uncle?"
"Third uncle knows a lot of beauties, of all ages. Nephew Chuyang, whatever kind you want, third uncle can find them for you."
"Hehehe."
The squinting expression made people speechless, Chen Chuyang pushed his third uncle away.
"Uncle Third, if you do this again, I will tell my mother."
"No, you kid, don't talk nonsense. Your mother is violent, and my third uncle can't bear it."
Third uncle Chen Shen was very afraid of Chen Chuyang's mother and became violent, but nothing happened to anyone else.
The most ruthless person in the Chen family is not Chen Yuan, but Chen Chuyang's mother. Many people are afraid of the mistress.
When Chen Shen was a child, he was often bullied.
It can be said that he has been very miserable since he was beaten since childhood, and he has always lived in the shadow of his sister-in-law.
Perhaps, this is also the reason why he has never gotten married.
How many, there are reasons for this.
"Forget it, I won't tell you anymore. If your kid complains about me, wouldn't I?"
Third uncle Chen Shen didn't want to see that scene. He couldn't help but tremble all over when he thought of his sister-in-law's appearance.
Chen Chuyang shook his head with a smile and watched his third uncle leave.
"Third uncle still hasn't grown up."
I counted the spiritual stones in my hand and found that there were quite a few.
Chen Chuyang put it away, blocked the gap in the fish pond, and started to store water.
The spiritual spring water flowed into the fish pond, and all the fry were put in, and they quickly adapted to the life inside.
